svg.title: Reload: the positive control
svg.desc: Before and after: Delta version 0 with files A to F, no new commit. The runner drops and recreates the external table and its QAP policy. Kusto reads all six files again, which the storage logs must show.
svg.text: Storage does not change. We drop and recreate the Kusto table and its policy,
so Kusto must read every file again. This proves the logs can see rereads.
adds A, B, C, D, E, F
adds A, B, C, D, E, F
every file: that is the point
Runs 6a to 7: 6 of 6 files reread (192.5 MiB) every time. The logs can see rereads.
If the logs never show these reads, the run fails: every 0 in that run would mean nothing.
